hotel_name: The Dunlin, Kiawah River, Auberge Collection

claims.text: The Dunlin is at 6000 Kiawah River Drive, Johns Island, South Carolina, about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.

findings.quote: The Dunlin is located at 6000 Kiawah River Drive, Johns Island, South Carolina 29455, about 20 miles and a 40 minute drive from downtown Charleston.

claims.text: The Dunlin is named after a local shorebird.

findings.quote: named after our beautiful local shorebird

claims.text: The interiors are by Amanda Lindroth Design.

findings.quote: Interiors are by Amanda Lindroth Design

claims.text: The architect was Robert Glazier, with a focus on Sea Island architecture.

findings.quote: designed by architect Robert Glazier (also of Rosewood, Montage, and Four Seasons properties across the globe) with a focus on Sea Island architecture

claims.text: Rooms have a cottage-inspired look with white-washed walls, honey oak floors, mint green accents and textural linen fabrics.

findings.quote: a cottage-inspired aesthetic, featuring white-washed rooms and honey oak floors with mint green accents and textural linen fabrics

claims.text: Generous porches offer riverfront views over the marshlands.

findings.quote: generous porches are the perfect place for morning coffee or a nightcap, offering a sublime oasis in the marshlands with expansive riverfront views

claims.text: The suites have outdoor soaking tubs.

findings.quote: we’re partial to the outdoor soaking tubs, ideal for relaxing under the stars after a day spent exploring the marsh

claims.text: The Riverfront Bungalows have kitchenettes, furnished porches and fenced-in yards.

findings.quote: Fully-equipped kitchenettes, graciously furnished porches, fenced-in yards and sweeping riverfront panoramas

claims.text: Linnette's is the signature restaurant.

findings.quote: Linnette’s, the signature restaurant

claims.text: The Cove is a riverfront pool club with a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.

findings.quote: The Dunlin has The Cove, a riverfront pool club featuring a heated pool, hot tub, poolside dining and cabanas.

claims.text: Activities include kayaking, paddleboarding, fly fishing, boat excursions, biking, exploring the farm and birdwatching.

findings.quote: Guests can kayak, paddleboard, fly fish, take boat excursions, take an art class, play mahjong, bike, explore the farm, birdwatch

claims.text: Epicurean Experiences include pop-up farm dinners and riverside oyster roasts.

findings.quote: pop-up farm dinners, riverside oyster roasts

claims.text: The property has an onsite farm and waterfront hiking trails.

findings.quote: an onsite farm and 20 miles of waterfront hiking trails
